play.source: MSL Gale Merged DEM 1 m v3 (USGS; MRO HiRISE stereo)
play.encoding: uint16 little-endian, row 0 = north; elevation = zMin + (v - 1) * zScale

surround.source: MSL Gale Merged DEM 1 m v3 (USGS; MRO HiRISE stereo)
surround.encoding: uint16 little-endian, row 0 = north; elevation = zMin + (v - 1) * zScale

mid.source: MSL Gale Merged DEM 1 m v3 (USGS; MRO HiRISE/CTX + MEX HRSC), decimated
mid.encoding: uint16 little-endian, row 0 = north; elevation = zMin + (v - 1) * zScale

far.source: MGS MOLA MEGDR 463 m global DEM (USGS mosaic)
far.encoding: uint16 little-endian, row 0 = north; elevation = zMin + (v - 1) * zScale

frame.projection: Mars equirectangular, sphere R=3396190 m, lat_0=0, lon_0=0 (IAU 2000)

origin.note: suggested local origin: x = E - easting, z = -(N - northing), y = elev - elevation

ortho.source: MSL Gale Orthophoto Mosaic 25 cm v3 (USGS; MRO HiRISE)

color.source: MSL Gale Orthophoto Mosaic 25 cm v3 (USGS; MRO HiRISE)
color.colour: brightness from the HiRISE mosaic; hue from the HiRISE blue-green/red filter ratio (PSP_009650_1755 colour strip) per brightness level - approximate natural colour

surround.source: MSL Gale Orthophoto Mosaic 25 cm v3 (USGS; MRO HiRISE)

slope.source: derived from MSL Gale Merged DEM 1 m (MRO HiRISE), 2 m posts, ~6 m baseline

sand.source: derived from HiRISE orthophoto brightness (dark, smooth patches > 2500 m2)

grid.encoding: uint8, one full grid per channel in the order listed, row 0 = north

channels.name: tilt
channels.description: slope of the plane fitted to each 6 m patch

channels.name: rough
channels.description: RMS distance of the 1 m elevation samples from that plane

channels.name: step
channels.description: largest height difference between neighbouring 1 m samples, plane removed

channels.name: sand
channels.description: share of the cell covered by dark sand

channels.name: loc
channels.description: predicted success of matching a ground photo to the orbital image

channels.name: hematite
channels.encoding: 0 = no CRISM coverage; 1..255 = relative band depth

localizability.formula: sqrt(var / (var + noise^2)) * (1 - highest correlation with another spot)

grid.source: MSL Gale Merged DEM 1 m v3 and Orthophoto Mosaic v3 resampled to 1 m (USGS; MRO HiRISE)
